title: Cómo bailar la Jota - Tutorial escolar ADMURM

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a friendly, encouraging tone, often addressing his students directly. He breaks down complex movements into simple, manageable parts, using clear verbal cues and physical demonstrations.

Teacher explains and demonstrates the basic step of the Jota.
